title: IntegrationAdapterRequest
description: Daemon -> adapter request envelope for one Backend operation. The adapter performs provider request/response mapping only; it MUST NOT record any ledger, idempotency, or side-effect-evidence state.

contractVersion.description: Must exactly match the daemon contract version.

operation.description: Operation name mirroring the per-domain Backend interface.

deadlineMs.description: Daemon-supplied per-operation deadline (Q1). Adapter MUST honor it.

resource.description: Normalized integration Resource projection. MUST NOT contain secrets.

credential.description: Per-call scoped, short-lived credential material (Q-clarification, FR-006). MUST NOT be persisted or logged by the adapter.
